terms.gloss: the neighbourhood: the people who live round about
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: neighbourhood, i.e. neighbours. The local community, on which Cato’s farmer depends.

terms.gloss: a community of citizens; a town and its people
terms.comment: The community as a political body (see state, a country).

evidence: Cic. Off. 1.157: commūnitās et conjūnctiō hūmāna (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Cicero’s word for what people share, not for a group of people.

terms.gloss: the body of Roman citizens living in a provincial town
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: persons associated in a provincial town for the sake of trade; the classical model for a community abroad.

phrases.latin: sī tē libenter vīcīnitās vidēbit, facilius tua vēndēs, opera facilius locābis, operāriōs facilius condūcēs
phrases.english: if the neighbourhood is glad to see you, you will sell your produce more easily, let out work more easily, hire labourers more easily

sources: Lewis & Short: vicinitas · Lewis & Short: civitas · Lewis & Short: communitas · Lewis & Short: conventus
